svg.aria-label: CodeReviewer Lens architecture. Eight specialist agents — Security (Fortify SAST, SonarQube vulnerability and hotspot rules, GitHub code and secret scanning), Quality (SonarQube rule-violation checks), Performance (SonarQube performance rules and LLM complexity reasoning), Guideline (Agentic RAG over Derivatives-IT C++/Java/Python coding guidelines), Dependency (Dependabot advisories and GitHub Dependency Review), Semantic (logic correctness and intent-vs-implementation, deterministic checks first then LLM), Architecture (import and AST boundary rules, a deterministic then LLM then verifier concurrency pipeline, and cross-component impact) and Conformance (evidence-gated requirement conformance — does the change deliver the authoritative Jira, Git or spec requirement, with an honest N of M covered matrix) — feed a synthesis lens that deduplicates, correlates and ranks findings into one verdict: PASS, WARN or BLOCK. Every LLM and embeddings call is held inside a fail-closed data-sovereignty boundary. The engine runs at pre-commit, commit, pull request, on-demand in VS Code, and via CI webhook.
svg.title: CodeReviewer Lens — eight specialist agents, one verdict, many entry points

g.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Multi-Agent AI Code Review Assistant — eight specialists, one verdict, many entry points
organised by concern — each implements specific tools, rules and standards
Implements Fortify SAST · Sonar vulnerability + hotspot rules · GitHub code and secret scan
Catches injection · auth · crypto · secrets · deserialization · memory safety
Implements SonarQube rule-violation checks — bugs, code smells, maintainability
Catches naming · complexity · dead code · documentation · duplication
Implements SonarQube performance rules · LLM algorithmic-complexity reasoning
Catches allocations · leaks · concurrency · latency · hot paths
Implements RAG over Derivatives-IT C++ / Java / Python written coding guidelines
Tiers standard guides · T7 overlay · repo-local — every finding cites file and section
Implements Dependabot advisories · GitHub Dependency Review (diff-scoped SCA)
Catches vulnerable / outdated packages · license posture
Implements Deterministic logic checks (offline) · LLM intent-vs-implementation
Catches off-by-one · wrong comparator · intent mismatch · error-handling gaps
Implements Import / AST boundary rules · concurrency (extract → LLM → verify) · impact
Catches boundary violations · races / deadlocks · risky cross-component ripples
Implements Jira / Git / spec requirement recovery · MECE obligations · verified coverage
Catches PARTIAL · MISSING · CONTRADICTED obligations — an honest N of M matrix
one engine · invoked at every stage of your workflow
Grounded in your C++ / Java / Python coding
standards — every claim traces to a guideline
page and section, never a generic LLM guess.
Every LLM and embeddings call is checked
against a fail-closed allowlist — an endpoint
outside your trust boundary is refused outright.
Secrets are redacted before any prompt leaves.
Air-gap capable · every verdict carries Containment.
